# NDB Notification Email — Template

> Plain-English notification to an affected individual under s 26WL of the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth).
> Edit the **{{placeholders}}** to match the specific incident. Have the Privacy Officer approve the final wording before sending. Send via the same channel ordinarily used to contact the individual (typically the email address on file).

---

**From:** Million Homestay Australia Pty Ltd <millionstay.com@gmail.com>
**To:** {{affected_individual_email}}
**Subject:** Important — a data incident affecting your MillionStay account

Dear {{first_name}},

We are writing to let you know about a data incident at MillionStay (Million Homestay Australia Pty Ltd) that has affected information you provided to us. We take your privacy seriously and we want to be open with you about what happened, what information was involved, and what you can do.

## What happened
On {{incident_date}}, {{plain_english_description_of_what_happened}}. We became aware of the incident on {{discovery_date}} and contained it on {{containment_date}}.

## What information was involved
The information about you that was involved in this incident was:

- {{field_1}}
- {{field_2}}
- {{field_n}}

The following sensitive information **was not** involved: {{list_of_things_not_affected_or_state_n_a}}.

## What we have done
- {{containment_action_1}}
- {{containment_action_2}}
- We have notified the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC).
- We are reviewing our systems and processes to reduce the chance of this happening again.

## What you can do
We recommend that you:

1. **Change your MillionStay password** by signing in at https://www.millionstay.com and going to Account → Settings.
2. **Be alert for suspicious emails or calls** that mention your booking details. We will never ask for your password by email or by phone.
3. {{specific_advice_for_this_incident — e.g. contact your bank, watch for unusual transactions, place a credit ban}}.
4. If you are concerned about identity theft, you can contact **IDCARE** — Australia's free identity and cyber-security support service — on **1800 595 160** or at https://www.idcare.org.

## How to contact us
If you have questions, please reply to this email or contact our Privacy Officer:

- **Email:** millionstay.com@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://www.millionstay.com
- **Address:** Melbourne, Victoria, Australia

## How to make a complaint
If you are not satisfied with how we have handled this, you can complain to the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC):

- Website: https://www.oaic.gov.au
- Phone: 1300 363 992
- Mail: GPO Box 5288, Sydney NSW 2001

We are sorry for any concern this causes you, and we appreciate your trust.

Sincerely,

{{Privacy Officer name}}
